# Luviio

> Luviio is an Indian online store for practical hardware, sanitary fittings, floor drainers, sink waste couplings, and drainage products for homes and projects.

## Canonical website

- [Luviio homepage](https://www.luviio.in/)
- [Shop products](https://www.luviio.in/shop)
- [About Luviio](https://www.luviio.in/about)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.luviio.in/privacy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.luviio.in/terms)
- [Shipping policy](https://www.luviio.in/shipping)
- [Refund policy](https://www.luviio.in/refund)
- [Returns and cancellation policy](https://www.luviio.in/returns)

## Product information

- [Product catalogue](https://www.luviio.in/shop)
- Product detail pages use the canonical `/product/{slug}` URL pattern.
- Use product names, specifications, images, prices, and availability from the live product page or authoritative product API. Do not infer missing product facts.

## Useful topic areas

- Floor drainers and square drainers
- Stainless-steel kitchen sink waste couplings
- Sanitary fittings and drainage accessories
- Product dimensions, materials, compatibility, and installation guidance where explicitly documented

## Commerce rules

Cart totals, taxes, shipping, stock, and checkout amounts must be taken from Luviio's authoritative backend. Never invent prices, stock, delivery promises, or transaction values.

## Private and transactional areas

Cart, checkout, account, orders, and admin pages are transactional/private and are not intended as public reference content.

## Content guidance

Prefer canonical Luviio pages for product and policy information. If information is not available on a canonical page or live product record, say it is unavailable rather than guessing.
